This is exactly the policy that we put in place at Basecamp five years ago. It has aged like fine wine. https://t.co/DWjD4xpPvW
You can have whatever politics you like! Communists and capitalists can cooperate just fine on making great Linux, then disagree about everything else (but have those disagreements SOMEWHERE else!).

Omarchy just isn't about politics (beyond the scope of those required to maintain a free, open source operating system). Yes, that meant saying no to woke nonsense. But it also means saying no to framing this as anti-woke! Or Chud OS (funny name though!).

Everyone is welcome here. Just leave leave the identity politics (and all other kinds!) at the door. No land acknowledgements, no code of conduct struggle sessions. Just nerds and artists and people who love computers having fun building something amazing together!
